{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|This peace treaty is vital to the interests of the New Republic.|Pwoe to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>}}
Faced with his diminishing support from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], self proclaimed [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Pwoe]] went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and signed a '''peace treaty''' with the [[Peace Brigade]] which had recently formed its own [[Ylesian Republic|government]].<ref name="Ylesia" />

During his speech to the [[Ylesian Senate]], the New Republic launched a surprise [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|raid]] on Ylesia and Pwoe was captured by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tigran Jamiro/Legends|Tigran Jamiro's]] forces.<ref name="Ylesia" />
